title: Example evidence-backed discoverability finding
observed_behavior: The example player attempts an unrelated control before discovering the primary interaction.

evidence.summary: At approximately 12 seconds, the player hesitates and tries a non-primary control before making the first valid placement.

recommended_improvement: Consider a minimal first-turn affordance that makes the primary interaction visually explicit.
expected_benefit: Reduce time-to-first-valid-action for new players without adding a persistent tutorial.
verification_approach: Repeat a first-time-player run and compare time/actions before the first valid placement.

metadata.note: This file validates the report contract and is not evidence about the real game.
